page.content:
Home of the Olympian gods, above the mortal world.

How Mount Olympus connects

  • Character: Zeus — Zeus rules the Olympian court on Mount Olympus.
  • Topic: Greek mythology — Olympus is the divine mountain of Greek myth.

What is Mount Olympus?

Mount Olympus is the divine mountain where Zeus holds court. The twelve Olympians feast there, and from it the sky-god hurls thunderbolts into the wars of heroes.

Key threads lead to Zeus and Greek mythology.
